products.name: Lovo (Genny)
products.note: Voice cloning and synthesis; likeness consent; commercial voiceover; synthetic media disclosure

reading.body:
Lovo offers a single product, Genny, positioned in the voice and audio category with capabilities spanning voice cloning, synthesis, commercial voiceover, and synthetic media disclosure, including a stated mechanism for likeness consent.

The consent and disclosure elements are the notable features here. Voice cloning raises direct questions about who authorizes use of a person's voice, and the data indicates Lovo addresses this within the product rather than leaving it to external policy alone. Synthetic media disclosure is similarly embedded in the product description, which places Lovo in a subset of audio AI companies that treat governance as a product feature rather than an afterthought.

The data does not cover infrastructure, model scale, compute requirements, or energy footprint, so no connection to power or buildings can be drawn from it. What it does cover is narrow: one company, one product, a short feature list, and a generation date of August 2026. Readers looking for market position, pricing, technical architecture, or regulatory status will not find it here.
